notes: The Gale Spire (dungeon_gale). templates\boss_template3.flp: strings_runs on strings_ostinato (Staccato Blend, insert 5), the flute line on choir (Ah Voice, insert 4: a wordless wind voice), timpani on timpani (Gong & Timpani, +1, insert 1), bell_tubular on harp (insert 2), bass_arco on brass_low (12 Low Strings +12, insert 8). v2 (review v1): built on projects\dungeon_gale_v1c.flp (bass Osc2 off, Osc1 7.32); levels from stems of that project rendered with every part at 0 dB (v1's came from the stock-bass render and missed by 10 dB); bell notes end at the next bell note (cap_at_next), timpani keys 47-53 play an octave down, bass advance 0.12 s.
